messages:
Sam (AE): FYI inbound from PrimeCare: they want a POC next week. Key requirements: enforced SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning for users + groups, strict RBAC with audit trail, and domain allowlist for @primecare.health. Any blockers?
Marta (SE): All core features supported on hosted for POC. Need their IdP metadata and a SCIM admin token. For RBAC we can map IdP groups -> roles. Note: Hosted rate limits apply, but for POC we can request a temporary bump.
Ibrahim: Their security team flagged cross-tenant SCIM token usage as a risk and asked about token scoping and rotation.
SecurityBot: SCIM tokens are tenant-scoped and revocable. We log SCIM token usage in audit.logs with IP and actor. Token rotation cadence: customer-controlled; we recommend rotating every 90 days.
Sam (AE): They also asked if we support SAML Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning and attribute-based role assignment.
Marta (SE): We support SAML JIT for user creation (provision on first login). For role assignment, prefer mapping groups from SAML or SCIM groups. We can accept SAML assertion attributes for role hints but group-based mapping is more robust.
LegalOps: If they request hosted eval with enforced SSO we need a simple trial addendum (standard template). If they insist on data isolation, Dedicated is needed and legal will need to sign T&Cs.
Sam (AE): Pricing question: can we waive charges for the 30-day eval and enable enterprise flags (SSO enforced + SCIM)?
Marta (SE): We can enable enterprise flags for a time-boxed hosted eval; propose 30 days. For higher throughput needs (>150 rps) suggest Dedicated trial.
Ibrahim: They want SCIM group sync to automatically grant and revoke access within 5 minutes. Is that possible?
Marta (SE): Delta sync runs every 5 minutes on hosted, full nightly sync. If they need immediate revocation, they should also configure SCIM to push group changes and we can handle immediate change events in the provisioning endpoint.
SecurityBot: Also note: domain allowlist enforcement works together with SSO enforcement to prevent creation of non-allowed accounts.
Sam (AE): I'll assemble an ask list for the customer: IdP metadata, SCIM base URL+token, example group names to map to our roles, service traffic estimates, and signed trial addendum if required.
Marta (SE): I'll prepare a short runbook with SP metadata, SCIM curl examples, and RBAC mapping recommendations.
LegalOps: Send me the customer's compliance questionnaire early; I'll pre-fill standard answers and flag anything needing escalation.
Sam (AE): Thanks team. I'll kick off the POC thread with PrimeCare and share updates here.
thread_summary: PrimeCare POC prep: confirm hosted vs Dedicated, collect SAML IdP metadata and SCIM tokens, clarify token scope/rotation, JIT provisioning and group->role mapping, trial addendum and pricing for 30-day eval, and runbook + audit logging notes.
